scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --workspace @commondays/web" "npm run dev --workspace @commondays/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @commondays/shared && npm run build --workspace @commondays/api && npm run build --workspace @commondays/web
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace @commondays/shared && npm run check --workspace @commondays/api && npm run check --workspace @commondays/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @commondays/api && npm run test --workspace @commondays/web
